docs.title: Clinical Context Ontology
docs.text: Description: Open ontology for tracking the clinical context of a patient including treatment rationale, diagnostic reasoning and issues related to care context. The goal is to capture clinical context around a patient's care, including the clinician’s interpretations and decisions which are not well represented in the problem focused EHR or other ontologies such as SNOMED CT. For more details, see the publication

docs.title: Use Cases
docs.text:
• Synthetic Data Generation
  • Extract Clinical reasoning (could use available case studies for training)

This ontology is under active development with a planned submission to the OBO Foundry. All 45 association classes have complete subject/object restriction axioms and IAO:0000115 definitions. Examples are provided as IAO:0000112 annotations.

docs.title: Stable release versions
docs.text:
After acceptance, the latest version of the ontology will be found at:

http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/clco.owl

(note this will not show up until the request has been approved by obofoundry.org)
